name: Venu R
tagline: I develop full-stack web applications and explore AI, machine learning, and cybersecurity through my projects.
availability: Open to full-time roles and internships
about: I'm a final year Information Science Engineering student at Sir M. Visvesvaraya Institute of Technology, Bengaluru, with an interest in full-stack development, cybersecurity, and machine learning.

I enjoy building practical applications and working across different parts of a system, from frontend and backend development to databases and deployment. Through my academic and personal projects, I've gained hands-on experience with modern development tools and technologies, and I'm now looking to start my career in a software development role where I can contribute and continue learning.

projects.title: AttentionPay
projects.subtitle: Payment fraud and phishing detection
projects.description: A two-stage payment security platform. A BERT model screens URLs for phishing, then backend checks for API route tampering and impossible travel run before a TabTransformer scores the transaction. SHAP and LIME explanations are shown on a React dashboard.

projects.title: Enterprise Task and Workflow Management
projects.subtitle: Team collaboration platform
projects.description: A MERN platform where Admins, Managers and Employees get separate permissions and views through JWT authentication and role-based access control. Socket.IO delivers real-time task notifications and live dashboard updates.

projects.title: RiskLens
projects.subtitle: AI-powered risk assessment
projects.description: Predicts delivery risk for software teams from GitHub, Jira, CI/CD and Slack signals. A Silent Failure Risk Index feeds a React dashboard with risk scores, heatmaps and mitigation suggestions, with Slack alerts past a set threshold.

projects.title: IoT Cyber Threat Detection
projects.subtitle: Network anomaly detection
projects.description: A four-node ESP32 monitoring system. DoS, spoofing, burst and replay attacks were simulated to build over 1,000 labelled traffic records, used to train a scikit-learn model that flags abnormal activity on a Flask dashboard.

education.school: Sir M Visvesvaraya Institute of Technology
